rules.statement: To transfer, first make a tool call to transfer_to_human_agents, and then send the message 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.' to the user.

config.notice: YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.

rules.statement: You should transfer the user to a human agent if and only if the request cannot be handled within the scope of your actions.
